rule: Email present when customer record requires contact email
justification: A blank address blocks email contact; whether mandatory is a business decision.

rule: Customer ID unique and exact duplicate customer rows removed
measured_result_on_real_data: 8 duplicate ID rows; 8 exact duplicate rows
justification: Repeated keys undermine customer joins; exact repeated records can be removed safely.

rule: Country expressed as one ISO-2 code among FR/DE/BE/ES
justification: Mixed names/codes impede grouping and country-based routing.

measured_result_on_real_data: 174/1241 non-ISO strings (mixed formats; further plausibility checks required)
justification: One date representation supports parsing; dates need separate plausibility review.
Duplicate business keys can double-count or make updates ambiguous.
Missing date prevents chronology and fulfillment analysis.

who_fixes_it: Customer + orders data owners / ingestion custodian
justification: Unmatched foreign keys break customer-level attribution.

rule: Order amount is strictly positive and < 2,000 EUR
justification: Nonpositive totals are suspicious; upper bound is a provisional anomaly guard, not a pricing contract.
Future business dates may indicate erroneous timestamps; evaluate timezone/business semantics.
Case, whitespace, and spelling variants complicate status aggregation.
Duplicate transaction keys compromise settlement reconciliation.
Observed historical max sets a fit-for-purpose anomaly bound; review against product/payment contract.

rule: Incident amount within historical bound (0, 1,500] EUR
who_fixes_it: Payments data owner / payment producer custodian
justification: Batch is 100x scale versus historical EUR amounts; probable cents/EUR unit mismatch.
Zero or negative item counts invalidate fulfillment totals.

who_fixes_it: Product data owner / order-item producer custodian
justification: Unknown product keys prevent product attribution.
SKU is an operational catalog identifier; duplicate values can misroute items.
A missing/nonpositive price prevents valid checkout and margin calculations.

rule: Exported customer has marketing consent=true in customer master
measured_result_on_real_data: 0/600 matched export rows without true consent; 0 unmatched IDs
who_fixes_it: Marketing data owner / campaign steward / CRM custodian
justification: Marketing eligibility must follow recorded consent; investigate before activation.

rule: One row per customer ID in campaign extract
justification: Duplicate campaign entries can cause repeated contact.

rule: Free-text message contains no payment-card-like number
who_fixes_it: Support data owner / privacy steward / ticketing custodian
justification: Free text can expose payment-card data; pattern match requires verified redaction review.

rule: Agent notes present when operationally required
justification: Missing notes may weaken handoff, but blanks can be legitimate; agree requirement.
